name: proteinmpnn
description: ProteinMPNN inverse folding on Aurora XPU; redesign chosen chains of a backbone PDB (others kept as fixed context) or score a native sequence. One row per PDB, returns designed sequences (seqs/*.fa) or score_only/*.npz.
_doc: Per-skill MCP spec (docs/SKILL_MCP_DESIGN.md §5). A thin 'skills' MCP tool proteinmpnn.design(inputs, defaults) validates each row against row_schema, write_files-stages inputs.jsonl + the runner, and calls loam-hpc run_batch(script_path=runner, inputs_path=jsonl, gpus=1, timeout_each). The install root resolves worker-side from the EXPORTED $PROTEINMPNN_PATH (then site.<system>.json['proteinmpnn']); the IPEX shim dir must be on PYTHONPATH. --device is ignored; the tile is pinned by ZE_AFFINITY_MASK. NOTE 'expects' names the DESIGN output; for a score_only row the output is out/score_only/*.npz instead.
